olympiad_full_name: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad
statement: The CentroAmerican Olympiad is annual; the 9th was in 2007. Find all positive integers $n$ such that $n$ divides the year in which the $n$th Olympiad takes place.
source: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad 2007

olympiad_full_name: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad
statement: In $\triangle ABC$, the angle bisector from $A$ and cevians $BD,CE$ concur at $P$ inside. Show quadrilateral $ADPE$ has an incircle iff $AB=AC$.
source: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad 2007

olympiad_full_name: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad
statement: $S$ is a finite set of integers such that for every two distinct $p,q\in S$, there exist (not necessarily distinct) $a\neq 0,b,c\in S$ with $p,q$ roots of $ax^2+bx+c$. Find the maximum size of $S$.
source: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad 2007

olympiad_full_name: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad
statement: A language uses letters $a,b,c,d,e,f,g$. Two words are synonymous if we can transform one to the other by: (i) $a\to bc$, $b\to cd$, ..., $g\to ab$; (ii) if a letter is between two equal letters, those can be removed. Show all words are synonymous.
source: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad 2007

olympiad_full_name: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad
statement: $m$ \textit{ends in} $n$ if $n$ is obtained by deleting some leading digits of $m$. How many three-digit numbers end in the product of their digits?
source: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad 2007

olympiad_full_name: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad
statement: Circle $S$, external point $P$, tangents touching at $A,B$. $M$ = midpoint of $AB$; perpendicular bisector of $AM$ meets $S$ at $C$ inside $\triangle ABP$. $G=AC\cap PM$; $D$ = intersection of $PM$ with $S$ outside $\triangle ABP$. If $BD\parallel AC$, show $G$ is the centroid of $\triangle ABP$.
source: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad 2007
